catalog.duplicate_rule: All rows with a repeated valid AppID are excluded from candidates; no arbitrary deduplication or source repair.
catalog.release_precision: Date-only YYYY-MM-DD; no release time or purchase-availability guarantee.

collection.authentication: ITAD-API-Key header from ITAD_API_KEY environment variable; no credential needed for this audit.
collection.caching: Atomic JSON replacement, configuration/provenance checks, compatible cache reuse, deliberate retry of incomplete matched histories, forced refresh archives old files.
collection.checkpoint_resume: Each completed game is cached; restart reuses valid cache. Manifest/report written after traversal; no durable per-attempt scheduler or bulk progress checkpoint. Existing smoke gate is pilot-hash-bound.
collection.next_authorization: First parameterize a separate collection namespace and approve a bounded smoke/coverage trial; no collection in Phase 8A.
collection.pacing: Default serial request-start spacing at least one second. Latency, throttles, retries and checkpoints add time; floors are not completion-time forecasts.
collection.pagination: Current code sends one array-returning history request per matched game; no cursor, offset, page or pagination loop. Provider limits/truncation remain unestablished offline.
collection.recorded_quota: Existing Phase 4 report records a verified-email default of 1,000 requests per five minutes, reviewed 2026-10-05. Account-specific/current quota is NOT verified by this audit.
collection.request_formula: U uncached games: Q=U + q*U*H before retries, where q is mapping fraction and H history requests per match (current implementation H=1). Add retry attempts; apply actual account quota.
collection.response_size_constraints: No documented response-size cap or truncation detector in current code; entire response/body and decoded history retained in memory and duplicated in cache wrappers. Provider cap unknown.
collection.retries: At most three attempts. Exponential waits 2s/4s for transient connection/408/5xx failures; 429 honors Retry-After. Missing/invalid Retry-After or waits >60s stop; 401/403 and redirects abort. Per-request timeout 30s.
collection.storage_note: Wrapper-size scenarios use the nonrepresentative pilot mean; new-history size may differ substantially. No full-catalog coverage or storage forecast is established.

evaluation_design.confirmatory_feasibility: New held-out games have uninspected local outcomes, but the 2025 event and model choices have already informed methodology. A preregistered sealed cohort offers untouched game outcomes, not an entirely fresh event-level confirmatory test. A future unexamined sale could provide stronger confirmation only after separate authorization and verified dates/data; none are assumed here.
evaluation_design.coverage: Report evaluation sizes and performance by pre-cutoff coverage flags/count bands fixed using development data. Separately report retrieval failure, empty response, ambiguity and date uncertainty; never select replacements for abundant histories or favorable targets.
evaluation_design.pilot_vs_sample: Report pilot and probability-sample results separately; use new-sample stratum inclusion weights for its restricted sampling frame where justified. Do not pool the pilot as a probability sample.
evaluation_design.preprocessing: All imputation, scaling, feature-selection rules and calibration (if later authorized) fit exclusively on chronological development training; exact historical cutoffs preserved.
evaluation_design.represented_games: Lock a new-sample development cohort before collection. Train on eligible 2023–2024 rows, evaluate its 2025 rows separately; pilot 2025 remains an examined diagnostic.
evaluation_design.tuning: Predefine training-only grouped/temporal resampling. No tuning on the examined pilot 2025 labels, new 2025 evaluation labels, missingness in evaluation, or importance computed on evaluation.
evaluation_design.uncertainty: Cluster uncertainty calculations by AppID, account for sampling design and small coverage strata; no generalization to post-2023-release titles, permanent-free titles, missing snapshot entries or the full Steam catalog is established.
evaluation_design.unseen_games: Within each new-sample release stratum, preassign AppIDs by an independent seed/hash to development versus sealed game-level holdout before collecting outcomes. Exclude EVERY holdout AppID from all training years; evaluate eligible 2025 holdout rows only.

local_evidence.known_external_potential: The existing lookup/history contract can be queried for new AppIDs in an approved future collection. Match rate and historical completeness are unestablished.
local_evidence.observation_warning: An empty response is observed local absence of returned records, not absence of discounts or a verified complete negative.
local_evidence.partition_rule: Before timestamp < start; inside start <= timestamp < end; after timestamp >= end. Observations, not continuous price coverage.
local_evidence.provider_coverage_for_uncached_games: UNKNOWN: no requests made; no provider-side availability inference.

features.changes_needed: Parameterize paths and expected cohort/pair counts; construct release-eligible pairs with same-day flags; validate labels/catalog/cache identities; keep exact 15-feature schema and strictly pre-cutoff observation selection.
features.cutoff: timestamp < exact UTC sale start. No carry-forward, interpolation, contemporary predictors or future observations.
features.determinism: Sort AppIDs, game-year keys, timestamps and raw indices; preserve duplicates, tied conflicts, currencies and exact cutoffs. Freeze source/configuration hashes.
features.missingness: Existing counts/flags distinguish no valid history; ratios, recencies and prices remain null. Preserve currency/conflict rules. Future preprocessing must fit only training data and explicitly retain/drop all-missing columns by a training-only rule.
features.performance: Current loader parses all game histories and keeps raw-record provenance in memory; three passes per game filter/sort history. For 5,000 games at three years, at most 15,000 pairs. Stream/chunk by game and bound provenance size after measuring actual records; no benchmark of expanded histories is possible here.

modeling_handoff.recommendation: A later authorized modeling phase needs cohort-aware expected counts and grouped chronological evaluation. Existing model wrappers reject null targets; ambiguous C labels and failed retrievals need a preregistered missing-target accounting policy, not relabeling or silent exclusion. Do not change or execute approved fitting scripts in this audit.

sampling.evidence_coverage_role: Known only after collection for new games; diagnostic strata, not inclusion filters or replacement rules.
sampling.inclusion_probability_note: k_h/n_h describes the stratified pseudorandom sampling design over randomized priorities; the realized fixed-seed sample is deterministic. Apply weights only to the new cohort, never to the diagnostic pilot.
sampling.interleaving: Sort within-stratum rank r by exact rational (r-0.5)/stratum_size; ties by stratum, SHA-256 and AppID. Take prefixes.
sampling.later_release_limitation: New games released on/after the 2023 start date are outside this balanced historical frame; no claim of representation for them or the full Steam catalog.
sampling.priority_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 42|appid, ascending within each release stratum; ties by integer AppID.
sampling.prohibited_selection_variables: Discount outcomes, evidence categories, price histories, snapshot prices/reviews/activity and provider matching success.
sampling.sampling_frame: Unique valid nonpilot AppIDs with consistent release dates strictly before every 2023–2025 sale start date.

scope: Offline feasibility only; no new histories/labels/features, collection, training, Phase 8B/8C or Phase 9.
